stages.purpose: Fine tune existing sidestep with planned 4cm alternating foot clearance, contact timing and stance slip penalties; not launched automatically.

failure_behavior: One full training attempt per stage; confirm on 32 fresh-seed episodes. If standing cannot be confirmed, retain snapshots and stop before sidestep.
native_cad_requirement: Native geometry evaluation requires all source meshes. --allow-proxy explicitly selects approximate geometry.
route_reason: Prepared for review only. Keep existing policy playback and source reference unchanged; do not start training until requested.
